RBI Kehta Hai: Stay alert! Do not click on unknown links received in SMS or WhatsApp claiming to update KYC or PAN. Banks never send links to update personal information.

Department of Telecom (DoT) Advisory: Beware of fraudulent calls claiming to be from DoT or police threatening mobile number disconnection or digital arrest. Law enforcement never arrests anyone over Skype or WhatsApp video call. Report to sancharsaathi.gov.in.

HDFC Bank Security Advisory: Dear Customer, beware of fraudsters offering high returns or part-time work from home on WhatsApp/Telegram. Bank officials never ask you to transfer funds to verify an account or share login credentials. For assistance visit hdfcbank.com.

SBI Customer Advisory: State Bank of India never sends APK files via WhatsApp or SMS for banking services or rewards. Installing unknown applications can lead to complete compromise of your device and funds. Always download YONO only from Google Play Store or Apple App Store.

Cyber Crime Helpline 1930: If you have been defrauded online, dial 1930 immediately or lodge a formal complaint at cybercrime.gov.in within the golden hour to maximize the chances of freezing stolen funds. Ministry of Home Affairs, Govt of India.

Barclays Security Alert: Fraudsters are pretending to be police officers or bank staff telling victims that their account is compromised and urging them to transfer money into a 'safe account'. Barclays will NEVER ask you to move your money to keep it safe. Hang up immediately.

ICICI Bank Notice: Fraudsters are searching Google for bank customer care numbers and creating fake toll-free listings. Please only refer to the official contact numbers printed on the back of your debit card or listed on www.icicibank.com.

Axis Bank Caution: Beware of fake SMS messages regarding electricity bill payment disconnection. Power distribution companies never ask you to call personal mobile numbers or download remote access apps. Pay bills only via official utility websites.

Federal Trade Commission (FTC): Scammers use fake package delivery texts to steal your credit card numbers. If you get an unexpected text about a delivery issue asking you to click a link or pay a redelivery fee, do not click. Check directly on the retailer's official website.

Lloyds Bank: Remember, entering your card details or OTP to 'receive' money or a refund is a scam. UPI and card payment systems never require an OTP or PIN to receive a credit. Stop and think before approving any request.

Kotak Mahindra Bank Alert: Never scan QR codes sent by buyers on OLX or Quikr to receive money. Scanning a QR code or entering your UPI PIN will always deduct money from your bank account, never credit it.

Monzo Security Notice: We will never call you to tell you your account is in danger and ask you to send money to another Monzo account or external bank. If someone asks you to do this, hang up and chat with us in the app.

Punjab National Bank Warning: Dear Customer, PNB never requests customers to download APK software like QuickSupport or AnyDesk. Sharing screen access gives fraudsters control over your banking transactions. Be vigilant.

Action Fraud UK: Alert: Fraudsters are impersonating HMRC promising tax refunds if you click a link and submit banking details. HMRC will never send notifications by text message regarding tax rebates. Forward suspicious texts to 7726.

Income Tax Department: Taxpayers are advised not to fall prey to fake SMS/emails promising instant income tax refunds upon clicking external links. Always verify your refund status directly by logging into incometax.gov.in.

Bank of America Security: Bank of America will never contact you asking for your password, debit card PIN, or one-time authorization code. If you receive a call asking for these details, hang up and call the number on your card.

Reliance Jio Security Update: Jio never sends messages asking subscribers to dial *401* followed by an unknown mobile number for SIM reactivation. Doing so enables call forwarding to scammers. Protect your SIM security.

Commonwealth Bank Australia: We will never send you a link directly to a login page asking you to verify your NetBank details. Always navigate to commbank.com.au independently or open the CommBank app.

Canara Bank Alert: Do not share your 16-digit debit card number, expiry date or CVV with callers posing as bank managers offering credit card limit increases. Canara Bank staff are prohibited from soliciting such information.

Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) Reminder: Retail banks in Singapore do not send clickable links in SMS messages to retail customers. If you receive an SMS with a link claiming to be from your bank, treat it as a scam.

Bank of Baroda Security Tip: Change your internet banking password every 90 days. Avoid using predictable passwords like your date of birth or name. Never write down your passwords or share them with family members.

Vodafone Idea (Vi) Safety Advisory: Beware of fraudulent messages threatening disconnection of your SIM card due to non-updation of KYC documents. Vi processes KYC updates only at authorized Vi stores with biometric verification.

Royal Bank of Canada (RBC): If you receive a text message claiming your RBC account has been temporarily locked due to unusual activity and providing a web link to resolve it, do not follow the link. Forward suspicious messages to phishing@rbc.com.

Federal Bank Fraud Alert: Beware of fake job offers demanding advance processing fees or cryptocurrency investments. Genuine employers do not charge candidate onboarding charges. Visit federalbank.co.in for verified news.

Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC): Be alert to fake parcel delivery notifications. Scammers send SMS messages claiming a parcel cannot be delivered without address confirmation or customs fee payment. Check with Australia Post directly via their official app.

HSBC Fraud Advisory: We will never instruct you to download third-party software or software tools to fix an online banking issue. If someone calling from HSBC asks you to install software, disconnect the call immediately.

DBS Singapore: Please note that DBS will never request your iBanking credentials, digiToken approvals, or SMS OTPs over unsolicited phone calls. Always verify callers by checking our official website at dbs.com.sg.
